However, England claimed an emphatic 6-1 win when the teams last met in the group stage of the 2023 FIFA World Cup, with Lauren James scoring a brace and Alessia Russo, Lauren Hemp, Chloe Kelly and Rachel Daly also finding the net. With analysis from Ian Wright, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan
